newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco voted top U.S. travel destination.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco voted top U.S. travel destination.

text.p: San Francisco was voted the favourite U.S. travel destination in a new magazine survey, followed by New Orleans, Charleston, S.C., Santa Fe, N.M., Boston, Seattle, San Antonio, Honolulu, New York and Savannah, Ga.
The results appear in the October issue of the magazine, to hit newsstands the week of Oct. 7.

Internationally, Sydney, Australia won top honours in the 9th annual reader survey by Conde Nast Traveller magazine, followed by San Francisco; Queenstown, New Zealand; Florence, Italy; New Orleans; Rome; Paris; Victoria, British Columbia; and Vancouver.
Singapore Airlines was voted the best international airline, while Midwest Express got the nod as the best U.S. airline.

Nearly 35,000 readers participated in the survey, and the final results were based on the first 30,124 entries that confirmed to the geographic distribution of the magazine's readership, the magazine said in a statement.
